recognize_zh: 這是反向移位 PCR（inverse shift PCR）的洋菜膠電泳圖：F8 內含子 22 倒位（Inv22）產生約 559 bp 產物，正常等位基因約 487 bp；看每條泳道是單一 559、單一 487，還是兩者皆有，就能判斷患者、正常人或帶因母親，用於 A 型血友病（hemophilia A）的基因診斷與產前診斷。
features: 2% agarose gel with 7 lanes; lane 2 is a DNA size ladder with bright 500 bp band
Lane 1 (Inv22 positive control): single band at ~559 bp
Lane 3 (mother): dominant ~487 bp band plus a fainter ~559 bp band, indicating heterozygosity
Lanes 5 and 6 (index case and chorionic villus sample): single ~559 bp band (Inv22 positive)
Lane 7: single ~487 bp band (unlabelled in legend, presumably normal control)
describe_en: Agarose gel electrophoresis of inverse shift PCR products for the factor VIII intron 22 inversion is shown with a size ladder in lane 2. The positive control (lane 1), the index case (lane 5) and the chorionic villus sample (lane 6) show a single ~559 bp product indicative of the inversion, whereas the normal sample (lane 4) and lane 7 show the ~487 bp wild-type product. The mother (lane 3) shows both wild-type and inversion-associated products, consistent with a heterozygous carrier; lane 3 also has additional faint upper bands. The legend lists six lanes while seven are visible, so lane 7 assignment should be confirmed. Findings are consistent with an inherited F8 intron 22 inversion (severe hemophilia A) in the index case and an affected fetus.

ddx.vs: Intron 1 inversion is detected by a different primer set and would give a wild-type result on intron 22 IS-PCR.

ddx.dx: F8 point mutation or small deletion
ddx.vs: Non-inversion variants give a normal IS-PCR pattern and require F8 sequencing.
Low FVIII from impaired VWF binding is excluded by VWF:FVIIIB assay and VWF gene testing, not by F8 inversion studies.
